text_block_list.text:
—Christmas.
With all kinds of leader horse girls at Tracen
Academy, how they spend it with their friends varies.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
To everyone on the student council, thank you for your hard work this past year.
As your president, you have my gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let's sip some sparkling juice
and review things together.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hyahaa! Dance, dance, dance!
Until you're too exhausted to stand!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Come on, let's link arms and do a line dance!
Let me in on it too!
Jungle Pocket, on the other hand...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
All right, today's the wrap-up party! Let's all shoot
the breeze, eat, and drink as much as we want!

text_block_list.name: L/Roars Member
text_block_list.text: Oooh!

She really does seem like the type to goof around with friends.
When I tried to join in on the fun...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Trainer, over here.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Don't 'huh' me.
You're coming this way. Come with me.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Alright, looks like we can take it easy here.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Take a seat. Order whatever you want.
Ah, and also...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
My bad, order somethin' for me too, will ya?
As long as it ain't spicy, I'm good.
And so, Jungle Pocket sipped her juice bit by bit...
choice_data_list: Hey, shouldn't you be heading back?
Hey, don't you need to head back?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Hm? Where to?
choice_data_list: I should get back to the others. They'll be lost without their leader...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but I'm an "ex"-leader now.
Besides...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: "It's always been like this. Whenever there's a party, he usually keeps to himself and stays quiet off in a corner."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Is that so? Everyone has times they want to be alone, don't they?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Times like this are necessary once in a while.
Besides—"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Being overly clingy isn't good either.
It'll just make the team lose its discipline.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Bringing a team together isn't about rules or forcing interactions. In short—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
As long as the leader is strong, that's enough.
Everything else will naturally fall into place.
choice_data_list: I see, so that's just how it works...

text_block_list.text:
Student Council President Symboli Rudolf is a ruler.
Captain Tap Dance City is a comrade.
However...

Jungle Pocket seems to be a charismatic leader
who leads from the front, setting an example for others to follow.
Just then—

text_block_list.name: Lip-Pierced Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Um... Pokke-san...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Hm? What's up?

text_block_list.name: Lip-Pierced Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Sorry to interrupt. Christmas presents from the fans have arrived for Pocket-san.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"A Christmas present?
What arrived?"

text_block_list.name: Lip-Pierced Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Cheap candy. Mostly an assortment of penny sweets.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Penny candy? I mean, I don't hate it, but that's a pretty cheap gift, ain't it?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Well, I'll take it with thanks. Just leave it over there.

text_block_list.name: Lip-Pierced Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Alright then...

One of her friends left behind some cheap candy and departed.
Along with that—

text_block_list.name: Lip-Pierced Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"A whole bunch of things.
An assorted fruit platter, comedy DVDs...
A massive pile of stuff Pocket-san would love."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is that so?
Heheh, looks like I'm pretty well-liked after all.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I'll take it with thanks.
Just put it over there.

text_block_list.name: Lip-Pierced Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Alright then...

One of her friends left behind a massive pile of presents
and departed. Along with that—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Hm? Where are you going?
choice_data_list: I thought I'd give them a little space.

text_block_list.text:
If she wants to be alone for a bit,
maybe it's best if I step away too.
Just as I turn to leave—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: You're fine. Stay right here.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Just stay, alright?
You don't have to do anything,
just eat and drink beside me."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: It just feels more calming that way.

Sitting back down calmly, we spent the time quietly.
Jungle Pocket was quieter than usual—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
To tell ya the truth... I don't really
need presents or whatever, anyway.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I'd appreciate it if I got it, but nothing in particular.
You've gotta seize what you want with your own hands.
Besides...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: If anything, I'm the kind of guy who prefers giving things away.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what kind of look she had on her face
when she got my present...

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text: What an absolute, utter nightmare of a present...

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text:
They promised they'd "make it worth my while," so I had high hopes,
only to have such a troublesome guest dumped on me.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, whatever do you mean?
You're a valued customer, a valued customer indeed.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Quick to comprehend, with excellent results, no?
Has there ever been a test subject who put up
numbers like these?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
The facilities here are—easy to run on.
Very much so...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Lately, I've started being able to see
my "friend" again.

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text: "I recognize your excellence. However, what you're saying makes zero sense, and I have absolutely no idea what you're talking about..."

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text: The only thing I understand are her words.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Tachyon-chan, Cafe-chan,
let's move on to the next training session!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"We don't have much time either.
I'll help you out!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but of course, Dants-kun.
Shall we go to a cafe, then?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Yes...
That said, I cannot overexert myself.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
We've made preparations up until now, and
the facilities here are wonderful, but...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"Even if she can run, it'll only be once. A full comeback
will take a considerable amount of time..."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
That's fine. Once, indeed.
However, what matters is the concentration—the concentration.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's just provisional, that's fine.
Let's apply the finishing touches, shall we?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer. Here's a reply from Tsuzuki.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: "I am currently preparing a return Christmas gift. Look forward to it," she said.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Haha, they might get pissed off and send weird stuff in the mail. Like rubber snakes or spiders.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Well, fair enough. Happy holidays, then, Partner.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
For me and for you. For all of us.
And for Tokyo and Hokkaido.

It was both a celebration and a rally.
Her spirits recharged, Jungle Pocket finally set out for the Arima Kinen.
